luiskr.com / core/utils/media/manifest / mediaKeyExists

function mediaKeyExists(url): boolean;

Defined in: core/utils/media/manifest.ts:62

Whether the manifest lists the CDN object behind url. Absolute URLs get the CDN_BASE prefix stripped to their bucket key; non-CDN URLs (gravatars, data URIs) always report false — they have no siblings.

Parameters

url

string

Full media URL or a raw bucket key.

Returns

boolean
